applicableAreas: All 39 individual townhome units across 8 buildings
findings.observation: Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) shows eight (8) locations labeled 'Electrical Meters' with one meter assigned to each building: Building 1 (north wall), Building 2 (west wall), Building 3 (north wall), Building 4 (north wall), Building 5 (east wall), Building 6 (west wall), Building 7 (south wall), and Building 8 (north wall). The site plan describes 39 total townhome units distributed across these 8 buildings, with buildings varying in size from 3,290 sf to 4,997 sf. Based on square footage and typical townhome unit sizes (approximately 1,000-1,400 sf per unit), each building contains approximately 3-5 units. The design provides one electrical meter per building (building-level service), not one meter per individual residential unit.
findings.reasoning: UCM § 1.3.8 requires that 'Each individual unit [shall have a] separate service drop and meter as required by AE standards.' The cited code section addresses customer electrical facilities and specifically contemplates individual unit service. In multi-unit residential development (such as townhomes), Austin Energy standards typically require individual unit metering to allow for separate billing, service control, and load management per residential unit. The proposed design with one meter per building serving 3-5 units per building does not provide the required individual unit service drops and meters. A building with 5 units served by one meter lacks the four additional required service drops and meters that UCM § 1.3.8 requires.
findings.comment: The proposed electrical design shows one meter per building serving multiple units, not separate meters and service drops for each individual townhome unit as required by UCM § 1.3.8. Revise the electrical design to provide individual service drops and separate electrical meters for each of the 39 individual townhome units. Coordinate with Austin Energy Design to confirm the individual unit metering requirements and service configuration for this multi-unit townhome development.
